prompt: Rendered in the rich, textured style of an oil painting, the scene captures a quiet moment at a busy airport gate. On the left, a woman in a yellow coat stands with her posture rigid, clutching a worn leather handbag tightly against her side. Next to her, a small boy in blue overalls sits on a metal bench, his legs swinging freely as he looks up at a large digital departure board hanging above. In the center, a man in a grey suit leans casually against a glass partition, checking his wristwatch with an air of impatience. To his right, a golden retriever lies calmly on the polished floor, resting its head on its front paws while observing the surroundings. Beside the dog, an elderly woman in a floral dress points toward the runway outside the window, drawing the attention of a young traveler in a green hoodie who stands nearby. The traveler turns their head to follow her gesture, creating a silent connection between the two figures. The background features blurred shapes of other passengers and luggage carts, adding depth without distracting from the main subjects. There is no visible airplane on the tarmac, keeping the focus entirely on the human and animal elements within the terminal. The warm hues of the interior lighting contrast with the cool blues of the evening sky visible through the expansive windows, enhancing the tactile quality of the brushstrokes that define each figure and object in this transient space.
